body:
Use the DETACHED gate form for credited full gates (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-09 20:03Z; supplements gate-credit-trap-background-timer, which is near its size limit).
Form: `pushd "<named root>" && node scripts/test-launcher.mjs full --detach --notify <coordinator session>`, run in the FOREGROUND. End the turn on STARTED. The coordinator relays completion. Run nothing in the root until the record lands, which can be about 20 s after the next checkpoint.
Why: on the host running since 6cd915ed (2026-10-09), a Claude Bash-BACKGROUND gate that FAILS gets no host record ("this session's own Claude work … has no verified completion"). Opus3's test-aaacf15b and test-efe8c5d6 show this; tracked as w-9a1f807bdf2d. A PASSING background gate was still credited: CSharpProof's w-cd57 gate test-9afe9985, recorded 17:42:08Z. The detached form records BOTH outcomes: CSharpProof's failed detached w-5f050 gate test-9294cc0b got record 1d64d004 (failed, exit 101) at 20:02:13Z.
